summary: Evaluate export-default expressions once and initialize a separate default export binding.

target.notes: This form evaluates the expression during module execution and does not turn an identifier expression into a live alias.

semantics.evaluation: expression once in module execution order

caveats: Do not rewrite export default x to export {x as default}; their liveness differs.

tests.name: identifier expression captured
tests.input:
// a.mjs: let x=1; export default x; x=2
// b.mjs: import v from './a.mjs'; console.log(v);

tests.name: side effect runs once
tests.input:
// a.mjs: let n=0; export default ++n; export {n}
// b.mjs: import v,{n} from './a.mjs'; console.log(v,n);
